behavioral_notes.observation: Provider-abstraction dispatch: rate_shipment(order) reflectively calls '<delivery_type>_rate_shipment' via getattr(self, '%s_rate_shipment' % self.delivery_type)(order). The base module ships only two built-in providers, 'fixed' (fixed_rate_shipment, price from the carrier product pricelist) and 'base_on_rule' (base_on_rule_rate_shipment, walks delivery.price.rule via safe_eval of variable+operator+max_value). External carriers are added by sub-modules that _inherit delivery.carrier and extend the delivery_type selection. Not visible in metadata (reflective dispatch on a Selection value).

The class docstring defines the carrier-connector SPI: an external provider implements <type>_rate_shipment, <type>_send_shipping, <type>_get_tracking_link, <type>_cancel_shipment and _<type>_get_default_custom_package_code. integration_level ('rate' vs 'rate_and_ship'), prod_environment and debug_logging (log_xml -> ir.logging) are the credential/sandbox/trace hooks for those real-carrier API calls. The base module defines the contract but makes no external call itself.

set_delivery_line(carrier, amount) removes any prior delivery line then _create_delivery_line builds a sale.order.line with is_delivery=True, product_id=carrier.product_id, price_unit=rated price, taxes mapped through the fiscal position; rate_shipment applies margin/fixed_margin and zeroes the price when free_over and order total >= amount. The shipping charge thus rides the order total into Quote-to-Cash invoicing. Computed in Python, invisible to metadata.

_match gates a carrier against a source (sale.order or stock.picking) by address (country_ids/state_ids/zip_prefix_ids regex), product tags (must_have_tag_ids/excluded_tag_ids) and max_weight/max_volume; available_carriers/_is_available_for_order drive the choose.delivery.carrier wizard and portal selection. base_on_rule additionally validates by running rate_shipment().get('success').

behavioral_notes.element: stock.picking tracking integration (cross-module, not in base delivery)
behavioral_notes.observation: tracking_number / carrier_tracking_ref and the send-to-shipper-on-validate behavior live in the separate stock_delivery module (addons/stock_delivery/models/stock_picking.py: carrier_tracking_ref field, carrier_tracking_url = carrier_id.get_tracking_link(picking), _send_confirmation_email triggering rate_and_ship at button_validate). The base delivery module only provides the delivery.carrier abstraction those pickings call; it has no stock.picking model and does not depend on stock.

delivery is the carrier-connector abstraction layer: extract_frontend reports 0 outbound HTTP call sites, no SDK imports and no API keys in this module. Real outbound carrier API traffic (FedEx/UPS/DHL/Easypost/Sendcloud, etc.) lives in delivery_* / *_delivery sub-modules that _inherit delivery.carrier and implement the <type>_rate_shipment/<type>_send_shipping SPI defined here. This is a gap #7 external-integration boundary realized as an extension point rather than a concrete connector.

information_flows: side-effect: delivery.carrier.rate_shipment -> sale.order.line (is_delivery=True) shipping charge on the order
side-effect: external provider sub-modules delegate <type>_send_shipping/<type>_get_tracking_link to real carrier APIs (gap #7)
cross-module: stock_delivery uses delivery.carrier to set stock.picking.carrier_tracking_ref and send-to-shipper at button_validate

external_integrations.character: carrier-connector abstraction (gap #7): defines the <type>_rate_shipment/<type>_send_shipping/<type>_get_tracking_link/<type>_cancel_shipment SPI; concrete external carrier API calls are implemented in delivery_* sub-modules, not here.

capabilities: Select Carrier for an Order (wizard + portal)
value_streams: Quote-to-Cash (shipping leg): add carrier -> rate shipment -> shipping cost line on order -> invoice estimated cost
Order-to-Ship: carrier selection feeds outbound shipment (tracking realized in stock_delivery)
policies: 1 record rule: multi-company scoping on delivery.carrier
_check_tags constraint: a tag cannot be in both Must Have and Excluded tags
margin >= -100% and shipping_insurance 0-100 SQL CHECK constraints
free_over / amount automation: shipping price set to 0 above an order-amount threshold
stakeholders: Carrier / Shipping Provider (delivery.carrier, external API in sub-modules)
metrics: rated delivery_price vs free_over threshold (no dedicated analytics model in base delivery)

classification.rationale: delivery extends the outbound-logistics (shipping/carrier) leg of the value chain, so its value_model is chain. It is classed as a support activity because it provisions shipping capability for the chain rather than performing the physical ship itself: it abstracts carriers (delivery.carrier), rates shipments and injects the cost into the order, while the actual outbound move and tracking are executed by stock/stock_delivery. It carries a noted gap #7 external-integration character - the module defines the carrier-connector SPI but the real external carrier API calls live in delivery_* sub-modules. APQC maps to 4.4 Operate outbound transportation / ship (Supply Chain).

standard_capabilities: shipping methods with fixed price and rule-based pricing (delivery.price.rule)
carrier availability matching by address, weight, volume and product tags
carrier selection wizard + eCommerce/portal carrier choice and pickup-location selector
margin / fixed margin and free-over-threshold free shipping
cash-on-delivery payment gating via the selected carrier
extension point for external carrier connectors (rate/ship/track/cancel SPI)
typical_fits: fixed-price or weight/price-rule domestic shipping out of the box
installing an Enterprise/community delivery_* connector for a real carrier
invoicing the estimated shipping cost on the sales order
common_gaps: any concrete external carrier API (FedEx/UPS/DHL/Easypost/Sendcloud) - requires a delivery_* connector module
real shipment creation, label printing and tracking - requires stock_delivery + a connector
custom rate logic / negotiated tariffs beyond delivery.price.rule
